tests.name: Reject stats request for non-existing player
tests.why: Verifies the API distinguishes between a real player with zero activity and a player that does not exist. A 404 is required — returning zeroed stats for a ghost player would be incorrect.

tests.name: Stats reflect zero activity for a new player
tests.why: Catches implementations that return 404 or crash on players with no game history. A freshly created player should have valid zeroed stats, not a missing resource error.

tests.name: Fire at out-of-bounds coordinates is rejected
tests.why: Ensures coordinate bounds are validated before inserting into the moves table, preventing corrupt game state. Negative or oversized coordinates must be rejected with 400.

tests.name: Fire out of turn is rejected with 403
tests.why: When player 2 tries to fire before player 1 has moved, the server must return 403 forbidden. Turn order must be enforced server-side.

tests.name: Valid fire shot on player 1 turn returns 200 with result field
tests.why: Player 1 firing on a valid cell during their turn must return 200 with a result of hit or miss and a next_player_id indicating whose turn is next.

tests.name: Move history is empty at game start
tests.why: GET /api/games/{id}/moves at the start of a game should return 200 and an empty moves array. A missing or null array would be invalid.

tests.name: Create game with out-of-range grid_size returns 400
tests.why: POST /api/games with a grid_size of 0 or a negative value must be rejected with 400. Accepting an invalid grid size would allow corrupt game state to be created before any player joins.
